question: Regulus seems to feel that Sirius and Capella are disgusting, but in arc 3 when he arrived where Rem and Crusch were, he and Batenkaitos didn’t argue, so was that just a coincidence where their opinions didn’t conflict? Was he also unfriendly towards Betelgeuse after he gained the witch gene of sloth? Sorry this ran so long.
answer: They simply didn’t come into conflict there, but they do both feel the other is disgusting. Life as an Archbishop beginning from zero awareness of friendship. Of course, Betelgeuse is also on bad terms with them.
